sonnet.problem: The statement bundles two separate claims: that the elders tell Balaam what Balak said (v7), and that Balaam tells them to stay the night so he can bring back the LORD's answer (v8). It also says "everything" Balak said, while the text only says they relayed "the words of Balak."
sonnet.rule: A true or false statement tests one claim.

sonnet.problem: The statement bundles two claims: that Balaam offers to go back home (v34), and that the angel tells him to go with the men but speak only what he is told (v35).
sonnet.rule: A true or false statement tests one claim.

sonnet.problem: The question says Israel "has just beaten" the Amorites. The text gives no timing for this and only says Balak saw "all that Israel had done to the Amorites." "Just" adds a time the text doesn't state.
sonnet.rule: Times stay true. No time in the text means none added.
